6.0 REFERENCE:

6.1 NABH : Accreditation Standards For Ayurveda Hospitals 2nd Edition April 2016.

7.0 OBJECTIVE ELEMENTS

7.1. The laboratory quality assurance programme is documented.

7.2 The programme addresses verification and/or validation of test methods.

7.3 The programme addresses surveillance of test results.

7.4 The programme includes periodic calibration and maintenance of all equipment.

7.5 The programme includes the documentation of corrective and preventive actions.

8. 0 PROCESSES

Refer to laboratory quality manual
